title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B8.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.9 (Peaked October 20, 2026 at 00:40 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.6 (Peaked October 19, 2026 at 09:03 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 354 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

If the Sun suddenly disappeared, Earth would keep orbiting nothing for about 8 minutes and 20 seconds before realizing Sunny was gone and flying off into space. 🌎🌞

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
